description: Anusvara-like sign producing an nasal '-om' / '-um' rhyme.
Visarga sign indicating a brief glottal stop or breathy '-ah' rhyme.

name_km: យុគលពិន្ទុ
description: Shortens preceding vowel sound in loan words or serves as a colon.
Mouse teeth mark; shifts O-series consonants to A-series sound register.
Triisap mark; shifts A-series consonants (e.g. ស, ប) to O-series register.
Bantoc; shortens the inherent vowel of a final syllable consonant.
Repha equivalent derived from Sanskrit 'r'; historically silent top mark.
Killer mark indicating that the base consonant is completely silent.
Crow's foot sign indicating exclamation or emphatic tonal pitch.
Sign eight used on isolated pronouns like ក៏ (kor - also/too).

name_km: សំយោគសញ្ញា
description: Combines with consonants to indicate explicit '-oa-' or short diphthongs.
Virama suppressing inherent vowel; rare in modern standard Khmer script.
Subscript consonant prefix control mark; transforms succeeding consonant into a foot.
Rare historical diacritic used in divinatory and Pali/Sanskrit orthography.
